_comment: Reference catalog. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Placeholders in {braces} must be kept.
app.title: P6 MCP Settings
app.footer: P6 MCP {version}. Runs only on this PC. Not affiliated with Oracle.
app.save_failed: The settings could not be saved: {err}
app.no_database: No database is selected yet: the P6 tools will answer "No database configured" until you add one, test it and click Use this database.
app.restart: Saved. Restart your MCP client (Claude Desktop, Cursor...) so it picks up: {what}.
app.broken: The settings file cannot be read: {err}
app.broken.save_first: The settings file is unreadable. Click Start over first: the broken file is kept beside the new one.
app.broken.moved: The unreadable file was kept as {path}.
db.intro: P6 MCP never picks a database by itself. Add one, test the connection, then click Use this database. The test only reads the file.
db.col.name: Name
db.add.suggested: Suggestions (not selected until you test and confirm)
db.remove.ask: Remove {name} from the list? The database file itself is not touched.
db.name: Name
db.pick.title: Choose a P6 Professional database
db.hint.test: Click Test connection. The file is opened read only.
db.writes.possible: possible when allowed in Tools and safety
db.writes.unknown_schema: read only: this P6 schema was not tested
db.writes.file_read_only: read only: the file is read only
db.warn.p6_running: P6 is open: writes will be refused until it is closed.
db.trust.title: Untested P6 schema
db.trust.ask: This P6 version was not tested with P6 MCP. Writes could store data P6 does not expect. Back up the database first. Allow writes on this schema anyway?
srv.stdio: stdio: each MCP client starts the server itself (recommended)
srv.http: Local HTTP on 127.0.0.1: one server shared by several clients
srv.transport.note: Both run only on this PC. HTTP accepts connections from this PC only, each with the access token.
srv.token.regenerate.ask: Clients using the current token will lose access until you give them the new one. Regenerate the token?
srv.token.note: Kept in the Windows Credential Manager, never in the settings file.
srv.token.error: The Windows Credential Manager cannot be reached: {err}
srv.status.stdio: Started by each MCP client when it needs it
tools.basic: Basic: {n} read-only tools, suited to small local models
tools.full: Full: all {n} tools, including SQL queries, XER files and (if allowed) writes
tools.allow.ask: Write tools change the P6 database directly, without P6's own checks. Each write needs a preview and your confirmation, and a backup is taken first. Close P6 before writing and press F9 in P6 afterwards. Allow write operations?
tools.backup: Back up the database before every write
tools.backup.ask: Without a backup, a wrong write cannot be undone. Turn off automatic backups?
tools.block: Refuse writes while P6 is running
tools.block.ask: P6 keeps data in memory and can overwrite changes made while it is open. Allow writes while P6 runs?
tools.writes.note: Off by default. The server checks these settings on every call.
tools.backups.note: Older automatic backups of a database are deleted beyond this number. Manual backups and safety copies made by a restore are never deleted.
tools.count: {n} of {total} tools offered. Changes apply after your MCP client restarts.
db.r.schema_untested: P6 {v}, not tested with P6 MCP (fingerprint {fp})
db.r.schema_trusted: P6 {v}, not tested, trusted by you (fingerprint {fp})
app.clients.new: MCP clients found without P6 MCP: {names}. Open MCP clients to register it.
app.clients.repair: The P6 MCP entry needs attention in: {names}.
cl.intro: MCP clients only read their own configuration file. Register adds a p6mcp entry to that file: other entries and the file's formatting are kept, and a copy of the file is saved first.
cl.unregister.ask: Remove P6 MCP from {name}? Only the p6mcp entry is removed.
cl.scan_failed: The clients could not be scanned: {err}
cl.restart_note: After registering, quit the client completely (also from the notification area) and start it again.
cl.detail.not_installed: {name} was not found on this PC.
cl.detail.not_registered: {name} is installed. P6 MCP is not in its configuration yet.
cl.detail.registered: {name} starts P6 MCP from this installation.
cl.detail.outdated: {name} has a p6mcp entry that does not match this installation (moved or changed by an update). Click Repair.
cl.detail.error: The configuration file of {name} cannot be read, so it is left untouched:
cl.detail.running: {name} is running: restart it after any change.
cl.legacy: {name} also has another P6 MCP entry: {keys}. With both, the client starts two P6 servers.
cl.legacy.title: Other P6 MCP entry
cl.legacy.ask: Remove the entry {key} from {name}? A copy of the file is saved first.
cl.snippet.http: Local HTTP, mcpServers format (copy includes the access token)
cl.snippet.note: Paste this into the client's MCP configuration. The HTTP variant needs the Local HTTP transport (Server page).
cl.detail.stdio_only: {name} only starts local servers: it gets a stdio entry and runs its own P6 MCP.
cl.detail.token_in_file: With HTTP, the access token is written in plain text in the configuration file of {name}.
cl.detail.token_prompt: With HTTP, {name} asks for the access token once (copy it from the Server page) and keeps it in its secret storage.
st.run: Start P6 MCP when I sign in to Windows
st.minimized: Start minimized in the notification area
st.note: Per user, no administrator rights needed. The notification area app hosts the local HTTP server; with the stdio transport, clients start the server themselves and this app is only needed to change settings.
st.not_registered: P6 MCP does not start with Windows.
st.mismatch: The Windows startup entry does not match the saved settings: click Save to fix it.
st.sync_failed: The settings are saved, but the Windows startup entry could not be updated: {err}
srv.status.no_tray: Not running: the notification area app hosts the HTTP server. Start P6 MCP Settings from the Start menu.
srv.status.save_first: Click Save: the HTTP server starts once the setting is saved.
tray.still_running: P6 MCP keeps running in the notification area. Right-click its icon to quit.
